title: Curl Pipe Guard
description: Stops an install one-liner from running a script you didn't mean to trust by showing, before a curl | sh (or wget, or iwr | iex) is copied or run, the script's real host and flagging plain http, raw IPs, shortened links, a host that isn't the product's docs domain, sudo, -k/--insecure, a missing checksum and a missing -f, then offering the same install as download, inspect, verify and run steps to copy instead.
